eyebrow: Kiva · Seattle shoot, Block 2 Yard · 29 Jul 2026 · Email thank-you
title: Vishal:
length: about 30 s plus the end card
headline: Kiva's CEO thanks a first-time donor and says what the donation does: it helps Kiva service loans, find new partners and reach the most vulnerable borrowers.
story: One take, straight to camera. Vishal says who he is, thanks the donor, and explains in plain words why a donation matters when loans go straight to borrowers.
Kiva drops this into the email a donor gets after a first donation, so it stands alone: no shared intro, no B-roll story, no hook text. It ends on his thank-you line and a short hold.
What is left to do: the picture and the words are approved. Only the captions change: Kiva's CEO-series caption style, with more space between letters and words (“the most vulnerable” is too tight).
do: Do not re-cut. Picture, words and order are approved. Fix the captions only.
Captions: Kiva green #2AA967, about 25% smaller, low in the lower third, a little less blur, more space between letters and between words.
Give “the most vulnerable” clear space between the words.
Name super after his self-intro, at 00:04: “Vishal Ghotge” / “CEO of Kiva”, small, lower corner.
End on “So thank you for helping us live our mission.” Hold about 0.6 s, then the end card.
dont: No hook text, headline or title card. This is an email video.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00. Frame 1 is his face and his first word.
Never the transcript's “Kodke”. It is Ghotge.
No B-roll story and no stats.

bp_intro: Picture is P1000798.MOV (A cam, the third First Donation take, the cleanest). Times are camera times in that clip, from the start and end of each line in the shoot's caption file. Sound is the lav WAV 071721_001 (about 0.5 s earlier than the camera): sync on the waveform. The transcript below uses Ghotge for the name and Atdhe's by-ear caption fixes. There is no visual.json and no frame on this page yet: the picture is the same seated shot for the whole video.

rows.visual: Vishal on the A cam, P1000798.MOV, seated in the yard in his green Kiva T-shirt, talking straight into the lens. Start on “Hi” (11:11.1). Frame 1 is his face and his first word. Stay on his face: he is talking to the donor.
rows.motion: Nothing on screen but captions. Email video, so the brief keeps frame 1 clean. Captions from frame 1.

voice.quote: Hi, I'm Vishal Ghotge. I'm the CEO of Kiva.

rows.music: Keep the approved bed, low under his voice from frame 1 (premiumbeat.com).

rows.visual: Same shot. Cut the pause before “And” to about 0.25 s. Stay on his face for the thank-you.
rows.motion: Name super at 00:04 for 3 s, small, lower corner: “Vishal Ghotge” / “CEO of Kiva”. Captions on.

voice.quote: And I want to personally thank you for your donation to Kiva today.

rows.visual: Same shot. He explains the idea in plain words: stay on his face (the brief keeps him on camera). If you trim a breath, hide it with the B cam P1000907.MOV (same moment about 4.6 s later on that clip).

voice.quote: You know, loans on Kiva go directly to our borrowers, helping them build better lives. And donations like the one you made actually help us service those loans.

rows.visual: Same shot, his face. Atdhe's caption fixes for this line: “It helps us”, “needed, it helps us find new partners, and make sure”.
rows.motion: Captions only. Give “the most vulnerable” clear space between the words: Atdhe found it too tight.

voice.quote: It helps us build the infrastructure needed, it helps us find new partners, and make sure that we are reaching the most vulnerable borrowers.

rows.visual: Same shot. End on “mission.” and hold his face about 0.6 s (to about 11:42.6). Cut before “and thanks for your contribution” (11:42.8).

voice.quote: So thank you for helping us live our mission.

rows.visual: End card on Kiva dark forest green #223829: the Kiva logo, then Give a little. Change a lot. and kiva.org. The logo is here only (the corner K is the one exception, see decisions).
rows.motion: End card: Kiva logo, then “Give a little. Change a lot.” and kiva.org. Nothing else.

“the most vulnerable” has clear space between the words.

The top-corner logo is Kiva's new green K, never on frame 1.

decisions.b: Kiva's own rule and Atdhe's Frame.io note on this cut keep Kiva's new green K logo in a top corner. The general blueprint rule says no logo before the end card. This plan keeps the K (never on frame 1). Atdhe confirms.
The general rule wants hook text on frame 1. The Thank You brief says these email videos have none, and this plan follows the brief. Atdhe confirms.
The end card folder only has Kiva's white wordmark, so the end card on this page uses it. Nick adds the new green K files to endcards/kiva if the end card should carry the K.
The Deadline column is empty. Nick sets it.
